summary: Correct canonical Inspector snapshot loading and standalone export bounds.
details: Browser validation counts object/array container depth rather than rejecting valid primitive leaves. Both consumer templates enforce the shared UTF-8 string, forbidden-field, section and read-only-header contracts.

Local consumers impose an 8 MiB input/output ceiling and 100 properties per object. The PowerShell exporter holds its input against writers and preserves an existing output on rejection. This is no general credential-redaction or digest-authentication claim.

Actual generated PowerShell and V8 validator controls cover canonical snapshots and opposing inputs. Committed SDK regeneration and assembled preview verification remain pending. No Factorio, player-package, save, compatibility or release proof is granted.
